_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Agyeman Snake wɔ {width}×{height} grid so.
Wo na wo hwɛ snake {player_id}. Nkrɔfoɔ a wɔfata: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (anaa w/s/a/d).
Botaeɛ: di akyɛdeɛ kɔsi pɛ anaasɛ di akyɛdeɛ kɔsi pɛ na woanya akontabuo a ɛkorɔn sen biara (turns {max_turns} dodoɔ).

board.after_moves: Ɔman a wɔdi so seesei no: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Oguanfo {player_id} wui esiane sɛ na ɔnte ase nti.

outcome.survived_win: Ɔbɔadeɛ {player_id} nyaa nkwa; wɔn a aka no nyinaa wui.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Wɔmaa awɔ no nyinaa wuwui prɛko pɛ.
outcome.outlived: Ɔbɔadeɛ no traa ase sen afoforo nyinaa.
outcome.turn_limit: Ɛdan no ano aduru - nea ɔwɔ nkontaabu a ɛkyɛn so na odi nkonim wɔ tie-break mu.
